sanskrit_verse:
आषोडशाद आद्वाविंशाच चतुर्विंशाच वत्सरात् ।
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां कालोपनयनिकः परः ॥
transliteration: āṣoḍaśād ādvāviṃśāc caturviṃśāc ca vatsarāt | brahmakṣatraviśāṃ kālopapannikāḥ paraḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the sixteenth year up to the twenty-second, and up to the twenty-fourth year of age, the time for the Upanayana ceremony is prescribed respectively for the Brahmana, Kshatriya, and Vaishya varnas.

Consciousness alignment occurs via prescribed rites at designated life stages
